items.title: In a distinguished triangle, if two out of three objects are perfect then so is the third
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that perfection is a two-out-of-three property for distinguished triangles (statement lines 12862-12867). The author gives two proofs (proof lines 12869-12883): the first combines the characterisation of perfect objects with the triangle lemmas for pseudo-coherence and for tor amplitude, and the second is a construction — reduce to strictly perfect representatives of two objects on a covering, represent the connecting map by a map of complexes, and identify the third object with the cone, strictly perfect by the cone lemma. H2: two independent short arguments, both written out.
